# [TASK] Add issue-history.sh to read and export GitHub issue body revisions

## Task
Add `infrastructure/scripts/issue-history.sh` to read and export the
revision history of GitHub issue bodies.

GitHub records every revision of an issue body and exposes it through the
GraphQL field `userContentEdits`. The field named `diff` returns the full
body text at that revision, not a diff, so the script produces the diffs
locally with `diff -u`.

Modes:

- no flag: list revisions with timestamp, editor and length
- `--diff`: unified diff between each consecutive pair of revisions
- `--rev N`: print revision N, 1 being the oldest
- `--events`: title, label, milestone and state changes from the timeline
- `--export DIR`: write every issue to `DIR/<number>.md` with state,
  labels and milestone in a header comment, so the backlog can be tracked
  in git

## No parent
No parent. Repo tooling with no user-facing slice, and no open Story covers
backlog tooling. Related to epic #251, which is what created the need to
compare issue revisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `issue-history.sh <n>` lists every revision of that issue's body
      (verified on #251, 4 revisions, and #253, 6 revisions)
- [x] `--diff` produces a non-empty unified diff where consecutive
      revisions differ (verified on #251 revisions 2 and 3)
- [x] `--events` reports label, milestone and state changes, which
      `userContentEdits` does not cover (verified on #264)
- [x] `--export DIR` writes one file per issue including state, labels and
      milestone (verified: 205 files, 840K)
- [x] `--rev` out of range and a non-numeric issue number both fail with a
      message instead of empty output

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Body edits made through `gh` are recorded under the token owner, so the
history cannot distinguish an agent edit from a human one. Both appear as
`liviuionesi`.
